label: POC Onboarding: Set Item Status
mcp_tool_description: Record the state of one POC test plan item (1.1.1 to 4.3.5) or prerequisite (P1 to P12): done, skipped, not_applicable or pending, with a note. Use not_applicable, with the reason, when the customer cannot or does not want to exercise an item in this POC (no SMTP, no LDAP, no SSO, no DNS record for a branded portal, no Terraform or Ansible); the scorecard then reports it as not applicable instead of failed. Returns every recorded item and a summary. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
